Digimeat Crop

Type
Crop
Growth Stages
7 (age 0-6)
ID
thedigimod:digimeat_crop

Usage

A farmable crop that grows into Digi Meat. Unlike vanilla crops, it has no separate seed item - planting it consumes a Digi Meat itself, since the block's "seed" is defined as Digi Meat in the mod's code.

It grows through 7 age stages (0-6) and needs a light level of 9 or higher on its farmland to progress, checked on random tick like any vanilla crop. Its growth speed is multiplied 1.5× compared to an equivalent vanilla crop under the same conditions (soil, light, hydration), so it matures faster than wheat.

The mod's lang file has no display-name entry for this block; "Digimeat Crop" here is the block's own registry id written out, not a confirmed in-game string.

Obtaining

Not obtainable as a block item; it can only be planted (using Digi Meat) and grown on farmland.
